 Shakib takes three wickets but Pokhara suffer heavy defeat in NPL
 Pokhara faced Janakpur Bolts in the match, which also featured another Bangladesh cricketer, Saif Hassan. But his innings came to an early end when he was bowled by Shakib.
 Written by : Khan Mutasim Billah Life 
 Posted - Nov 01, 2026, 10:57 pm 2026-11-01T22:57:42+06:00 
 Updated - Nov 01, 2026, 10:57 pm 2026-11-01T22:57:42+06:00 
 Shakib Al Hasan made a strong impact with the ball in the ninth match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL). Two other Bangladeshis, Mahedi Hasan and Mohammad Saifuddin , also contributed with the ball for Pokhara Avengers. However, none of the three could make much of an impact with the bat, and their team eventually suffered a heavy defeat.
 Pokhara faced Janakpur Bolts in the match, which also featured another Bangladesh cricketer, Saif Hassan . But his innings came to an early end when he was bowled by Shakib.
 After winning the toss, Pokhara captain Kushal Bhurtel elected to field. Janakpur made a steady start and did not lose a wicket during the powerplay. However, Shakib changed the game after coming into the attack.
 Get Latest Cricket Updates on WhatsApp He was extremely economical and picked up three important wickets. His first victim was Moeen Ali , who scored 21 off 16 balls. Shakib then bowled Saif Hassan, who managed just 1 run off 9 deliveries. Janakpur captain Harmeet Singh was his third victim, departing for nine off eight balls.
 Shakib finished with impressive figures of three wickets for just four runs in his three overs.
 Mahedi completed his full quota of four overs and picked up a wicket, including a maiden over. Saifuddin was more expensive but also managed to claim a wicket. Bangladesh's bowlers took all of Janakpur's first five wickets before Chamika Karunaratne struck twice in the final over. Janakpur finished on 147 for seven.
 However, Pokhara struggled badly in the chase. Dinesh Kharel and Mahedi Hasan were dismissed early. Captain Kushal tried to hold one end together, while Shakib joined him at the crease.
 But Shakib could not score quickly enough under pressure, managing just nine runs off 17 balls. Kushal's dismissal for three off 24 deliveries made things even worse for Pokhara, who failed to recover.
 Among the other Bangladeshis, Mahedi scored eight off four balls after opening the innings, while Saifuddin was dismissed for a duck after facing just two deliveries at number seven.
 Follow google news channel to get news of BDCricTime. Meanwhile, Saif Hassan made an impact with the ball, picking up two wickets for Janakpur.
